name: Jana Toom - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT with recommendations to the Commission on just transition directive in the world of work: ensuring the creation of jobs and revitalising local economies
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to propose a new law on a fair green and digital transition at work. The law would give workers a right to training during working hours, require employers to inform and consult workers early when change is planned, and require national transition strategies. It would also support small businesses and local job creation in regions affected by the shift away from fossil fuels.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission for a draft law by 31 January 2027.
- **Who it affects:** Workers, employers, small businesses and regions hit by the transition.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to propose the law; Parliament and Council would then negotiate it.
